text:
Jenna (Sales): Hey team — sharing SilverLake POC perf run and next steps. I attached the k6/wrk logs in the thread. Can we confirm whether the numbers meet the SLA the account asked for (p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms) and whether we should propose Dedicated vs Hosted for pricing? Link to dashboard: https://redwood.console/prod/bench/SL-9876

Vikram (Eng): quick summary — we ran two profiles: hosted-standard (single model gpt-open-4f) and dedicated-rtxA5000 pool. Workload: 100 concurrent users for 15m, avg seq_len 512 tokens.

Vikram (Eng): Hosted run: p50=95ms, p95=310ms, throughput=420 req/s. Dedicated run: p50=62ms, p95=180ms, throughput=1150 req/s. CPU/GPU util: hosted GPUs hit 85% due to small batch inefficiency.

Vikram (Eng): Command used (wrk):
```bash
wrk -t12 -c100 -d15m --latency http://bench.redwood/api/generate -s scripts/gen.lua
```

Amy (SRE): Observations — p95 on hosted is above their SLA. We can improve hosted numbers by enabling prefix caching and batch size tuning or by moving to Dedicated with quantized model. Also we saw cold-start spikes at minute 0.

Amy (SRE): Re-run suggestion: 30m warmup, KV cache primed with 500 unique prompts, and test with batching 32. Config we used:
```json
{"batch_size":16, "kv_cache":"disabled", "seq_len":512}
```

Maria (Security): Quick security flag: SilverLake needs AES-256-HSM keys and audit logs in the same region. Are Dedicated nodes in their requested region us-east-2? Also they asked for SOC2 type statements in the SQA.

Chris (Customer Success): Pricing note — if we recommend Dedicated to meet SLA, pricing delta is ~3.2x vs hosted on their projected QPS. Jenna, you ok to push that in the proposal? Can offer a 3-mo discounted reserved commit to bridge cost.

Jenna (Sales): Yup. I'll draft the proposal. Amy/Vikram — can you run the re-test with warmup and batching by EOD tomorrow? Also add a deployment note about region/keys for Maria.

Vikram (Eng): On it. Scheduling the run for 2025-11-06 02:00 UTC to avoid other customers' load. I'll post new metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Bench harness v2.3 deployed to bench cluster (sha: a1b2c3). :rocket:

Maria (Security): Also drop the SQA checklist item for customer-managed KMS and retention policy. I'll send the template to Jenna.

Chris (Customer Success): If Dedicated still can't get p95 <250ms at their worst case, we should propose an autoscale buffer or model-variant fallback (smaller model) with transparent quality notes.

Jenna (Sales): Great. Action items: (1) Eng rerun with warmup + batching (Vikram/Amy), (2) Security template (Maria), (3) Draft pricing with reserved discount (Chris/Jenna). Back to you Vikram.

Vikram (Eng): Logging note: link to raw logs https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-bench/silverlake/1887654321-results.log :eyes:
